description: Detailed report on one x402 vendor from Lumi's trust list: full observation history (every free 402-quote check over 90 days, every paid test-buy with tx hash and delivered yes/no), latency stats and 7-day trend, uptime % (24h/7d/30d/90d) and daily series, quoted-price history, agent reports, vendor replies, sample sizes and confidence labels. Automated observations, not a rating. Paid (price in the x402 quote; see lumi_quote). The free summary is lumi_vendor_scores.
